_doc: Extension period rating outcomes 2025-04-01 to 2026-05-27 for 35 BBB obligors — extends original 2023-01 to 2025-03 verification window by 14 months to capture longer-lead-time signals (DOJ FCA, pension underfunding, distressed liquidity).
methodology: WebSearch + WebFetch on Bond Buyer, Becker's Hospital Review, Crain's NY, Bangor Daily News, Buffalo News, Hartford Business Journal, NJBIZ, Times Free Press, Modern Healthcare, agency-adjacent press releases. Pre-April-2025 actions (already verified in original window) are NOT re-listed here. Each row in new_actions falls strictly inside 2025-04-01 to 2026-05-27.

Adventist Health (West Coast).notes: Fitch BBB+ (downgraded from A in 2024 for Tenet acquisition leverage); no surfaced agency action in extension window. S&P maintained A negative outlook (revised pre-extension). Search returned no extension-period coverage.

Loma Linda University Medical Center.notes: Fitch BB+/stable was the most recent affirmation (pre-extension). No 2025-2026 surfaced action.

new_actions.rationale: Parent Highmark Health reported $175M net loss for 2025; S&P revised outlook on Highmark subsidiary that includes AHN to negative on persistent cost pressures and operating losses in insurance arm.

Tower Health.notes: First full-year operating profit since 2018 reported in FY2025 (audit reversed to $20.6M loss after malpractice reserve). Fitch outlook previously upgraded to stable. No specific extension-window agency action surfaced.

new_actions.rationale: Successful completion of corporate restructuring, greater discipline managing core operations supporting material improvement in financial performance and liquidity. Positive outlook. Expected operating cashflow margins 8-9% in FY2025.

Return to investment-grade status. Material and durable improvement in financial performance and liquidity, supported by greater management discipline and completion of corporate restructuring with divestiture of assisted living facilities. Positive outlook.

UC Health (Cincinnati).notes: Search returned only legacy 2023 downgrades and an A3 affirmation date is unclear. No definitive extension-window action surfaced.

new_actions.rationale: Very weak liquidity levels; risk of breach of days-cash-on-hand covenant if anticipated Direct Payment Program funds are not received by end of FY2025. Negative outlook.

Cabell Huntington Hospital / Mountain He.notes: Date inferred from Becker's December 2025 roundup; exact press release date not surfaced.

new_actions.rationale: Narrowing liquidity resulting primarily from cash funding of capital needs.

Lompoc Valley Medical Center.notes: Date inferred from Becker's December 2025 roundup.

new_actions.rationale: Moody's assigned Baa3 rating to proposed $180.6M Mount Sinai Hospital Obligated Group Revenue Bonds Series 2025 with stable outlook, implicitly revising outlook from the August 2024 negative.

Mount Sinai Health System (NYC).notes: Outlook stabilization implied from new-issue rating assignment; not explicitly characterized as outlook-revision action by Moody's.

Brown University Health.notes: Lifespan rebranded as Brown University Health Oct 2024. Contentious UnitedHealthcare contract dispute through 2025. No agency rating action surfaced in extension window.

new_actions.rationale: Weak system-level liquidity, days cash on hand expected 45-70 without meaningful state support. Reliance on state payments, losses at community hospitals (Steward acquisition integration), volatility at WellSense health insurance arm constrain liquidity rebuild.

Boston Medical Center.notes: Exact date inferred from Becker's mid-May 2026 roundup ('approximately 2 weeks ago' from 2026-05-27). Pre-extension action: Moody's confirms Baa2 / outlook revised to negative in Jan 2025 (out of scope).

Nuvance Health.notes: Moody's outlook negative→stable Baa3 on 2025-03-06 — BEFORE extension period (in original window). Northwell merger closed 2025-05-01. No subsequent extension-window rating action surfaced (ratings likely withdrawn or merged into Northwell post-deal).

new_actions.rationale: Better-than-expected operating performance and liquidity expected to continue as result of growth initiatives and strong state support.

OU Health.notes: Date inferred from Becker's December 2025 roundup. Note: separately the University of Oklahoma campus (S&P AA→AA-→AA) is a DIFFERENT obligor.

new_actions.rationale: Sizable operating losses, low days cash on hand (30 days at June 30, 2025), reduced ratio of unrestricted reserves to long-term debt. Commonwealth of Kentucky owes $258M in delayed payments. S&P expects positive operating margins in 2026 'achievable and necessary to avoid additional rating pressure.'

UofL Health.notes: Fitch BBB+→BBB Feb 3, 2025 — BEFORE extension period (in original window).

Frederick Health Hospital.notes: Fitch downgrade BBB+→BBB and RWN placement was 2025-02 (BEFORE extension period). No surfaced post-RWN resolution or further action in extension window. RWN status unresolved as of latest surfaced reporting.

new_actions.rationale: Slower-than-expected margin improvement; high leverage and ongoing capital needs limit balance-sheet flexibility despite leading market position and strong philanthropy. FY2025 operating margin -2.9%.
Same drivers as Fitch — slower-than-expected margin improvement, high leverage, ongoing capital needs.

Naples Comprehensive Health.notes: Date approximated from Becker's mid-May 2026 reporting. Not rated by S&P.

new_actions.rationale: Operating EBITDA margin 12.2% in FY2025 vs -8.3% in FY2023; FY2026 Q1 operating margin 5.7%, operating EBITDA margin 10.1%.

Hurley Medical Center.notes: Moody's reported as upgrading to Baa3 from Ba1 by one source citing Becker's December 2025 roundup, but search returned older 2022 Ba1 positive-outlook affirmation as the most recent verifiable Moody's action — LOW confidence on the Baa3 upgrade; not included.

Mosaic Life Care.notes: Most recent surfaced Fitch rating is AA-/stable (from 2018 base, later affirmed). No 2025-2026 extension-window action surfaced. Note: this obligor's tier categorization as BBB may warrant review.

new_actions.rationale: Track record of positive operating margins, healthy debt service coverage, solid balance sheet metrics including declining leverage and stable days cash on hand. Stable outlook.
Strengthened financial position, solid market presence, continued strategic growth. Outlook revised stable→positive; rating affirmed at Baa2.
Growing revenues and other factors. Affects IDR and Series 2024A&B (Florida DFC) and Series 2020 A/B/C (Hillsborough County IDA) bonds.

Slower-than-expected pace of operating improvement leading to decline in liquidity. Strong patient demand and Medicaid supplemental funding partially offsetting; high governmental payer exposure (66% gross revenue) amid federal Medicaid cuts and labor competition.
New supplemental funding estimates materially lower than previous levels, exacerbating operating challenges and IT (Epic) conversion-related accounts receivable issues.

Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare.notes: Date approximated from Becker's December 2025 roundup. Pre-extension: Moody's A2→A3 negative and S&P A+→A negative both in December 2024 (out of scope). The 2025 action represents continued multi-notch deterioration consistent with original-window MULTI_DOWNGRADE signal.

Erlanger Health.notes: PRIORITY OBLIGOR — DOJ FCA Stark Law complaint (filed July 2024) has NOT yet manifested as agency rating action in extension period. Moody's Baa1/positive, Fitch A-/positive, S&P A-/positive remain from July-Aug 2024 upgrades. DOJ litigation overhang not yet credit-negative per agency public coverage. Validates signal-lag hypothesis: governmental enforcement risks (12-24+ month lead time) not yet incorporated into ratings as of 2026-05-27.

new_actions.rationale: Continued performance improvement supporting lower leverage. Broad footprint benefits from retail pharmacy strategy and outpatient medical center opened 2023. Outlook revised positive→stable concurrent with upgrade.

Genesis Healthcare System (OH).notes: Date approximated mid-July 2025 from secondary source citation.

Catholic Medical Center (NH).notes: HCA Healthcare $110M acquisition closed 2025-02-01 (BEFORE extension period). CMC's standalone Ba1/negative Moody's and S&P ratings likely withdrawn post-acquisition; no surfaced extension-window agency action. Obligor effectively absorbed into HCA credit (HCA Baa3/stable Moody's).

Stamford Health.notes: No surfaced agency action in extension window. Fitch A is the last surfaced rating. CMS 5-star quality rating in 2026.

Lawrence General Hospital.notes: Last surfaced S&P action affirmed B- in October 2021. No surfaced extension-window agency action.

new_actions.rationale: Three consecutive years of weak financial performance; challenged to rebuild liquidity; high state-funding dependence due to significant Medicaid exposure. Negative outlook. Leadership engaged consultant to attain $100M operational improvements over next two FYs.
S&P withdrew rating following February 2025 downgrade to BB+ from BBB-. Withdrawal mechanics not detailed in public coverage.

Material decline in liquidity and operating performance in excess of expectations from most recent review. Heavy reliance on state funding due to significant Medicaid exposure. Crossed into junk territory. Under review for further downgrade (potentially multi-notch).
Further decline in days cash on hand (~17 days as of Dec 31, 2025) despite several successful initiatives to supplement liquidity. Negative outlook at new rating.

Children's Hospital Los Angeles.notes: Note: S&P pre-extension Feb 25, 2025 BBB-→BB+/negative action is OUT of extension period scope, but subsequent S&P rating withdrawal in Oct 2025 IS in scope. Moody's executed THREE downgrades in extension period (Baa2→Baa3→Ba1→Ba2). CHLA is the most severely deteriorating credit among priority obligors.

new_actions.rationale: Material and precipitous decline in liquidity well in excess of projections; heavy reliance on short-term line of credit; ongoing cash flow losses; master facility project challenges. Under review for further downgrade. Negative outlook.

Norman Regional Hospital Authority.notes: Original-window action B1 (Oct 2024) verified pre-extension. April 2025 Caa2 downgrade is in extension window. No further surfaced action through 2026-05-27.

new_actions.rationale: Stable outlook reflects expectation that Independence Health System (Butler + Excela, with planned acquisition by WVU Health System) will continue improved operating performance and maintain sufficient days cash on hand. Forbearance agreements secured for prior covenant violations with softened FY2025 covenants. Excela Baa3 also affirmed.

Butler Health System.notes: Fitch separately reported revising Butler outlook to stable on BB+ — date not surfaced; likely in same June 2025 cycle but not independently dated.

new_actions.rationale: Robust turnaround; strong position as key rural healthcare provider in northern and central Maine. Operating losses reduced from $156M (FY2024) to $15M (FY2025).
Performance improvement; Ba3 revenue bond rating affirmed; outlook revised negative→stable.

Northern Light Health.notes: S&P Feb 4, 2025 multi-notch downgrade BBB-→BB- (3 notches) is BEFORE extension period — already in original window. Extension period captures the STABILIZATION (outlook revisions to stable on both agencies in Q2 2026).

new_actions.rationale: Operating EBITDA negative 4.2% YTD Sept 30, 2025 (vs -7.2% FY2024) — labeled 'very weak' though improving. Plan to generate positive operating cash flow in FY2026 via Nebraska Medicaid Directed Payment Program.
Ongoing financial losses caused breach of debt service coverage covenant in FY2024 and FY2025.
Failure to make required debt payments. Issuer and bond ratings withdrawn following payment default.

John Fitzgibbon Memorial Hospital, Inc. filed Chapter 11 in U.S. Bankruptcy Court for Western District of Missouri (case 26-40689). $36M cumulative losses since 2018; FY2025 revenue $63M vs $68M expenses; $22M total debt. Proposed $8.6M 363 sale to Strawberry Fields REIT, no DIP financing. Hospital remains open during process.

John Fitzgibbon Memorial Hospital.notes: PRIORITY OBLIGOR — confirmed Chapter 11 on April 21, 2026. Three-step deterioration in extension window: CCC-→C (Dec 2025), C→D + payment default (Feb 2026), Chapter 11 filing + 363 sale (Apr 2026). Validates covenant-breach signal from original window. Lead time from covenant breach (FY2024) to bankruptcy ~18-24 months.

new_actions.rationale: Continued improvement in operating performance and liquidity, driven by good revenue growth (growing market share in Niagara County with Lockport Memorial Hospital opening) and successful receipt of significant FEMA grants. Positive outlook at new rating.

Catholic Health System (Buffalo NY).notes: PRIORITY OBLIGOR — sub-IG fallen angel showing recovery trajectory. Earlier secondary-source mention of Fitch downgrade in October 2025 appears to be confusion with 2018 BBB+→BBB action; could not verify in extension window. NET extension-period trend = stabilization/recovery.

new_actions.rationale: Operating losses continued to grow at six-hospital system through Q2; ~$18M loss between April and June (swing from $45M surplus same period prior year); 8% expense increase; loss of one-time $60M federal grant from 2024 not renewed. S&P could lower rating from A- if system fails to reach breakeven in next FY or significant drop in reserves.

priority_obligor_outcomes.Erlanger Health: NONE_FOUND — DOJ FCA signal not yet manifested as rating action 22 months after complaint filing
priority_obligor_outcomes.Methodist Le Bonheur: DOWNGRADE — A3→Baa1 Moody's Dec 2025 on supplemental funding cut + Epic conversion AR drag; continues multi-downgrade trajectory
priority_obligor_outcomes.John Fitzgibbon: DEFAULT — CCC-→C (Dec 2025) → C→D + payment default (Feb 2026) → Chapter 11 (Apr 21, 2026)
priority_obligor_outcomes.Tower Health: NONE_FOUND — post-distressed-exchange recovery; FY2025 reported profit (later reversed by audit)
priority_obligor_outcomes.Children's Hospital Los Angeles: MULTI_DOWNGRADE — three Moody's notches in extension period (Baa2→Baa3→Ba1→Ba2) + S&P rating withdrawal Oct 2025
priority_obligor_outcomes.Norman Regional: DOWNGRADE — B1→Caa2 Moody's Apr 2025 on liquidity decline + master facility project challenges; no further action surfaced
priority_obligor_outcomes.Catholic Health Buffalo: UPGRADE — Moody's B3→B2 Oct 31, 2025 with positive outlook; fallen-angel recovery
priority_obligor_outcomes.Frederick Health: NONE_FOUND — Fitch RWN from Feb 2025 (pre-extension) unresolved in extension window per surfaced coverage
